command:
$env:JAVA_HOME = "C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr"
$env:Path = "C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr\bin;" + $env:Path
"=== STATE ==="
$old = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA "Android\Sdk"
$new = "C:\Users\Abdullah G\Desktop\Website\flip-scanner\Android\Sdk"
"old exists: $(Test-Path $old)"
"new exists: $(Test-Path $new)"
if(Test-Path $new){ "new contents:"; Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $new | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name }
"=== LICENSES DIRS ==="
"old licenses: $(Test-Path (Join-Path $old 'licenses'))"
"new licenses: $(Test-Path (Join-Path $new 'licenses'))"
"=== ACCEPT LICENSES ==="
$smNew = Join-Path $new "cmdline-tools\latest\bin\sdkmanager.bat"
if(Test-Path $smNew){ 1..40 | ForEach-Object { "y" } | & $smNew --licenses 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 3; "licenses step done" } else { "sdkmanager NOT FOUND at new location" }
"=== INSTALL PACKAGES ==="
if(Test-Path $smNew){ & $smNew --install "platform-tools" "platforms;android-36" "build-tools;36.0.0" 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 8; "install step done" }
"=== VERIFY ==="
"adb present: $(Test-Path (Join-Path $new 'platform-tools\adb.exe'))"
"android-36 present: $(Test-Path (Join-Path $new 'platforms\android-36'))"
"build-tools 36 present: $(Test-Path (Join-Path $new 'build-tools\36.0.0'))"
